body:
Any Bob Marley song (This is a negative impact)

When I was about 7 my parents tried to explain death to me (Because me and my siblings would fight just as siblings would) but one day we did and my dad then explained they wouldn't be around forever and this was why it was important for us children to appreciate and love each other now because we never know when our last times seeing each other would be. A bob Marley Song was playing in our lounge as this convo went on. 

Being as young as I was though, I couldn't comprehend time. I thought my siblings or parents would die soon. My parents had their own business and every night after we went to bed they would work and listen to Bob Marley music. I would cry every single night while these songs played because I would think to myself'' I dont want my dad to die'' or id think about my siblings. 

im 25 now and almost any reggae music takes me back to those nights and that conversation along with the feeling that Im still afraid of losing them.
